title: 2026.43: A New Era
content:
Welcome back to This Week in Stratechery!

This week marks a new era for Stratechery, which is now presented by Stripe. I’m excited about what this partnership can unlock, starting with in-person on-video episodes of Sharp Tech. Check out the YouTube video above (or watch it on Stratechery); and, for subscribers, look forward to a bonus episode showing up in your subscriber feed every Sunday morning (add your feed on sharptech.fm).

Here were a few of our favorite topics this week:
